topic: Original strict conjugacy and actual adjoint first cohomology; independent continuity equivalence

primarySources.title: The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
primarySources.author: Gaetan Chenevier
primarySources.review: Remark 2.29 relates the determinant tangent space to adjoint H1 for an irreducible representation. Section 2.30 treats topology separately. Our representation-lift classification does not require or claim determinant reconstruction.
primarySources.formalUse: Prove actual strict conjugacy iff equality in the genuine algebraic H1 quotient, and separately prove continuity iff continuity of the original cocycle. No continuous cohomology, pseudodeformation representability, or arithmetic lifting result is inferred.

primarySources.formalUse: The matrix lift/cocycle and strict-conjugacy results are preliminary algebra. They supply neither associated Galois representations nor local p-adic Hodge conditions, universal ring representability, patching or Selmer vanishing.
